title: Charge circling in a magnetic field
back: Magnetic force qvB is always towards the centre: r = mv/qB, period 2πm/qB (independent of speed).

title: Field on the axis of a loop
back: Sideways components cancel; axial ones add: B = μ₀IR²/2(R² + x²)^{3/2}.

title: Wire field and parallel currents
back: Field lines are circles round the wire; like currents attract with μ₀I₁I₂/2πd per metre.

title: Moving coil galvanometer
back: Concave poles + soft-iron core give a radial field, so NIAB = kφ and φ ∝ I.

title: Magnetic force on a charge
back: Lorentz force adds qE when an electric field is present.

title: Circle in a magnetic field
back: Doubling v doubles r but leaves T unchanged.

title: Biot–Savart law
back: dB is perpendicular to both dl and r̂.

title: Field at the centre of a coil
Field of a long straight wire
back: From Ampère’s law with a circular loop; B ∝ 1/r.

title: Force between parallel currents
back: Like currents attract. Defines the ampere (2×10⁻⁷ N/m at 1 m).

title: Torque on a current loop
legend: θ = angle between B and the normal
back: Net force zero in a uniform field; τ = m × B.

title: Galvanometer to ammeter / voltmeter
back: Ammeter: small shunt in parallel. Voltmeter: big resistance in series.
